subject: Human Evolution
title: The Acheulean Hand Axe
description: A quick win: understand The Acheulean Hand Axe.

hook.text: For 1.5 million years, one tool design dominated the planet. The hand axe is history's longest trend.

buildup.text: Acheulean hand axes are teardrop-shaped, flaked on both sides, and strikingly symmetrical.

discovery.text: Making one requires planning the final shape before you start—a mental leap beyond Oldowan tools.

twist.text: Some archaeologists think hand axes were also sexual displays—showing off cognitive fitness to mates.

climax.text: Found from Africa to England to India, the hand axe proves Homo erectus spread a shared culture.

quiz.question: What was revolutionary about the Acheulean hand axe?
options: It was the first metal tool
It required planning a symmetrical final shape
It was only used for hunting
